title: A ring embeds in the product of its prime localizations
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring. For every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset R$ let $R_{\mathfrak p}$ be the localization at $\mathfrak p$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Then the canonical ring homomorphism $R\longrightarrow\prod_{\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Spec}R}R_{\mathfrak p}$, $r\longmapsto(r/1)_{\mathfrak p}$, is injective. In particular, if every $R_{\mathfrak p}$ is reduced, then $R$ is reduced.
